message.content: The sea typically appears blue—especially when it's clear and calm—but its hue can shift depending on factors such as depth, sunlight angle, water composition, surrounding scenery, and atmospheric conditions. In shallow waters it may look turquoise; near shorelines it might appear greenish or even brownish during storms or after heavy runoff. On cloudy days or over deep ocean, you often see darker blues or almost black tones.
